title: FOIA releases of thousands of UFO pages
summary: Richard Dolan tells of FOIA releases of thousands of UFO pages, about late 1970s-early 1980s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then suddenly, thousands of pages of military failed interceptions and CIA memos and FBI investigations.

plain: A UFO researcher, Richard Dolan, says that in the late 1970s and early 1980s, requests under the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, suddenly freed thousands of pages about UFOs. He says they included records of military jets failing to intercept objects, memos from the CIA, America's spy agency, and investigations by the FBI, its federal police. To him this shows the government took the subject seriously while saying little in public.
